_about: Short spoken + shown reactions after each /grade. Pick one line at random (avoid repeating the last one). Sounds are in content/sfx/ (served at /static/content/sfx/NAME.wav); play the sound, then speak the line. Goofy, never mean, nothing about culture or looks.

_rules.streak: after 3, 5 or 10 correct in a row (replace {n})
_rules.milestone: when a milestone from milestones.json fires (that file has the specific line)

lines: Ten out of ten, no notes.
